component.name: Orca
component.summary: AI orchestrator for running coding agents side by side

description.p: This is a community package of Orca, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream Linux build unmodified and adds Claude Code and git.
Orca runs coding agents side by side in terminal panes and worktrees, tracks their status in one workspace, and integrates with GitHub, Linear, SSH hosts, and the Orca mobile companion.

Permissions: by default this package grants display, network, notifications, secret storage and audio. Everything runs inside the Flatpak sandbox with no access to host commands, so terminals only see what the sandbox allows.
Claude Code runs as claude in any terminal. It is downloaded from Anthropic when this package is installed, and updates with the package, not by itself.

Terminals run bash, with history kept between sessions. ~/.local and ~/.claude (Claude's settings and login) are persisted so they survive restarts and updates, unless you grant home access below, which makes them your real home directory's. Orca's settings are in ~/.var/app/com.stablyai.orca/config/orca (~/.config/orca inside the app).
A few broad capabilities are not granted by default; enable only the ones you need with "flatpak override":

ul.li: Open existing projects anywhere in your home directory: flatpak override --user --filesystem=home com.stablyai.orca
Reuse host SSH configuration and keys for Git/SSH workflows: flatpak override --user --filesystem=~/.ssh:ro com.stablyai.orca
Expose local devices for advanced computer-use workflows: flatpak override --user --device=all com.stablyai.orca
